name: Choice Band
fx: +50% Attack. After its first action it keeps using that same move for the rest of the battle, whatever its odds.

name: Choice Specs
fx: +50% effect on its Support moves (bigger heals and buffs), with the same lock-in as Choice Band.

name: Choice Scarf
fx: +50% Speed, with the same lock-in as Choice Band.

name: Life Orb
fx: Offensive moves use +30% of Attack. Loses 10% max HP each time it uses one.

name: Leftovers
fx: Heals 8% max HP at the end of every round it's on the field.

name: Focus Sash
fx: At full HP, survives a hit that would knock it out with 1 HP. Once per battle.

name: Rocky Helmet
fx: Any enemy whose move hits it loses 12% of its own max HP.

name: Protective Pads
fx: Never triggers retaliation like Rocky Helmet or Poison Point when it hits.

name: Weakness Policy
fx: The first time it takes a super-effective hit, gains 50% Attack for the battle.

name: Assault Vest
fx: +25% max HP, but it can't be taught Support moves.

name: Safety Goggles
fx: Can't be hit by enemy Splash, Full front row, Back row or Full field moves.

name: Heavy-Duty Boots
fx: Exempt from compaction: it can choose to stay in the back row.
